entry.content: The terminal and file browser are now more responsive when working in a Cloud Storage bucket that is mounted through the file browser. Frequent background checks for non-existent files are now cached instead of repeatedly querying Cloud Storage, which previously could make actions such as listing files or running terminal commands take several seconds.
entry.summary: We've enhanced the responsiveness of the terminal and file browser when accessing mounted Cloud Storage buckets. By caching frequent background checks for non-existent files, we've significantly reduced delays in listing files and running terminal commands, making your workflow smoother.
entry.title: Fixed: Improved responsiveness in Cloud Storage file browser

entry.content: Cloud Storage buckets that you mount through the file browser are now automatically re-mounted after the instance is restarted or is stopped and started. Previously the mounted folder could be left behind as an empty, unusable directory that had to be manually removed and re-mounted.
entry.summary: Cloud Storage buckets mounted via the file browser will now automatically re-mount after instance restarts or stop/start cycles. This resolves an issue where mounted folders could become unusable and require manual intervention.
entry.title: Fixed: Automatic re-mounting of Cloud Storage buckets

entry.content: Fixed an issue where a notebook's cells and their outputs could be unexpectedly erased. The automatic reload of an open notebook (which keeps it in sync with changes made to its file on disk) is now restricted to run only while the Gemini CLI is in use, so notebooks are no longer overwritten at other times.
entry.summary: An issue causing notebook cells and outputs to be erased has been resolved. Automatic notebook reloading is now restricted to when the Gemini CLI is in use, preventing unexpected overwrites.
entry.title: Fixed: Notebook content no longer erased

entry.content: Cloud Storage buckets that you mount through the file browser are now automatically re-mounted after the instance is restarted or is stopped and started. Previously the mounted folder could be left behind as an empty, unusable directory that had to be manually removed and re-mounted.

entry.title: Fixed: Automatic re-mounting of Cloud Storage buckets

entry.content: Agent Platform Workbench instances internal agents now honor custom CA certificates installed on the host OS (e.g. via a custom VM image), fixing TLS certificate verification failures when Google API traffic is routed through a customer-managed proxy.
entry.summary: Internal agents in Agent Platform Workbench now support custom CA certificates configured on the host OS. This resolves TLS verification issues when routing Google API traffic through customer-managed proxies.
entry.title: Change: Agent Platform Workbench CA Certificate Update

entry.content:
Secure Boot is compatible with GPUs

You can now enable Secure Boot on Agent Platform Workbench instances that have a GPU attached. Secure Boot with GPUs is supported on the workbench-instances-2603 VM image and the workbench-container-2606 custom container, which include a Secure Boot-signed NVIDIA GPU driver so the driver loads under Secure Boot. For more information, see Create an instance.
entry.summary: Agent Platform Workbench instances with GPUs now support Secure Boot. This feature is available on specific VM images and custom containers, ensuring the NVIDIA GPU driver loads securely. This enhances the security posture of your AI development environments.
entry.title: Feature: Secure Boot Now Supports GPUs

entry.content:
Python 3.12 base containers for Agent Platform Workbench custom containers

You can build custom containers for Agent Platform Workbench instances using Python 3.12 base containers, in addition to the default Python 3.10 base containers. The Python 3.12 standard and slim base containers are available at the following URIs:

  • us-docker.pkg.dev/workbench-images/gcr.io/workbench-container-2606:latest
  • us-docker.pkg.dev/workbench-images/gcr.io/workbench-container-slim-2606:latest
entry.summary: You can now build custom containers for Agent Platform Workbench instances using Python 3.12 base images. This provides an updated Python environment for your custom container needs.
entry.title: Feature: Python 3.12 support for custom containers
